recipe_version.title: Argentine Baked Beef Empanadas with Olives and Boiled Egg
recipe_version.description: Pastry discs filled with ground beef cooked with onion, red bell pepper, cumin, sweet paprika, oregano, and chile flakes, folded with chopped boiled egg, green olives, and scallions, crimped, brushed with beaten egg, and baked golden.

ingredients.name: large eggs
ingredients.note: 2 boiled for the filling, 1 beaten for brushing

ingredients.name: green olives
ingredients.display_name: pitted green olives whose label lists olives, water, salt, and lactic acid

ingredients.name: empanada discs
ingredients.display_name: 5-inch empanada discs for baking whose label lists wheat flour, water, palm oil, salt, and sugar

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 400 F with racks in the upper and lower thirds, and line the 2 sheet pans with parchment. Dice the onion and bell pepper, chop the olives, and slice the scallions.

steps.title: Boil 2 eggs
steps.body: While the filling cooks (overlap stated): bring 4 cups water to a boil in the 2-quart saucepan over high, about 6 minutes to come to a boil. Lower in 2 eggs, simmer 10 minutes, cool under the cold tap 2 minutes, peel, and chop.

steps.title: Cook the filling
steps.body: Heat the oil in the 12-inch skillet over medium-high, about 1 minute. Cook the onion and bell pepper until soft, about 7 minutes. Add the beef and cook, breaking it up, until no pink remains, about 7 minutes. Stir in the cumin, paprika, oregano, chile flakes, and salt for 1 minute, then spoon off excess fat.

steps.title: Cool the filling
steps.body: Spread the filling on a large plate and let it cool 10 minutes, then fold in the chopped eggs, olives, and scallions.

steps.title: Fill and crimp
steps.body: Beat the remaining egg in the small bowl. Divide the filling evenly among the 16 discs, about 3 tbsp (a scant 1/4 cup) each, brush the edge with egg, fold into a half-moon, and press with the fork or fold-crimp the edge. Set 8 on each sheet pan and brush the tops with egg.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake until deep golden, about 20 minutes, switching the pans halfway. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

coverage_contribution: The catalog has no hand pies or empanadas; Argentina appears only as chimichurri steak. A make-and-bake beef dinner.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with argentine-chimichurri-steak-potatoes: a ground-beef pastry baked in hand pies, not grilled steak with potatoes. Compared with cuban-picadillo-rice: spiced beef sealed in pastry with egg and olives, not saucy beef over rice. Compared with greek-spanakopita: a beef filling in single crimped discs, not spinach and feta in phyllo.
not_duplicate_of: Not Jamaican beef patties (no curry or turmeric pastry) and not fried empanadas.
